author: TeIq
content: **Pre-flight (architect, rust-quality applied).** New polaris-backend/tests/key_rotation.rs. 3 tests: (1) AC-15 e2e — emit L1 with K1, rotate, emit L2 with K2, verify both via signing_key_history lookup; (2) Failure-injection — kill mid-rotation at last_step='key_written', resume via --resume id, complete cleanly; (3) Append-only triggers — DELETE / illegal-UPDATE raise P0001, legal active_until-set UPDATE succeeds. testcontainers PG 16-alpine. Module-level test allows.
